seasonal_policy.spring: Reuse available greener grass and healthy sycamore canopy
seasonal_policy.summer: Reuse actual existing golden dry grass; sycamore leaf-on only for managed moisture context
seasonal_policy.autumn: Reuse dry seasonal ground plus localized existing sycamore dry leaf/litter art; not universal deciduous canopy
seasonal_policy.winter: Reuse cooler/greener ground; optional bare deciduous tree and conditional distant summit snow after a high-country storm; yard stays snow-free

wind_QA.motion_implementation: Reused tree_motion.py functions, compound canopy and authored dry-leaf paths

review_limits: Source masks provide visual coverage, not 3D physical volume, collision, supports or bird anatomy.
Source-side schema proposal awaits parent relay; current V1 does not admit these PNG/mask fields.
Snow is an alternate whole far-mountain raster, not a separable snow-only layer; skyline drifts slightly and fine texture resynthesizes.
Managed sycamore seasonal color is conditional; left scene-edge canopy crop intentional, source masters preserved; outer-twig joins provisional.
Strict shared logical pixel-grid/style, physical scale/camera fit and runtime/owner acceptance remain pending.
